title: Groundhog Withdrawal
hint: Do the changes in withdraw() survive the end of the call?
explanation: acct is a memory copy of the account. Setting acct.balance = 0 (and acct.lastWithdraw) changes only the copy; storage keeps the old balance and the old timestamp, so the user can call withdraw() again and again, cooldown included. Line 22 does exactly what it says; the real problem is that acct is a copy. Use a storage reference (Account storage acct).
